desc:
• DELICIOUS TASTE: Made with real honey, each box of crunchy lattice squares brings an irresistibly sweet taste your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box in your pantry for a morning food that's ready to eat any time

  • WHOLE GRAIN: Helps get your day off to a good start with 13g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

  • GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

  • VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Beyond the delicious taste, every serving is a good source of 12 vitamins and minerals, and made without high fructose corn syrup, or artificial flavors or colors

  • CONTAINS: One 12.5 oz box of Honey Nut Flavored Chex Cereal
features:
Features

Sweet honey nut flavor: Made with real honey and natural almond flavor for a lightly sweet and nutty taste.

Made from whole grain corn: Each serving contains 13–14 grams of whole grain to support a healthy diet.

Gluten-free: Ideal for individuals with gluten intolerance or those following a gluten-free lifestyle.

No artificial ingredients: Free from artificial flavors, colors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Vitamin and mineral fortified: A good source of 12 essential vitamins and minerals, including iron, calcium, and vitamin D.

Crunchy corn squares: The signature Chex texture makes it satisfying to eat with milk or on its own. 

 Benefits

Tasty and kid-friendly: A delicious and familiar cereal flavor that appeals to all age groups.

Supports whole grain intake: Helps meet daily whole grain recommendations for a balanced diet.

Safe for gluten-sensitive individuals: Certified gluten-free for added dietary safety and peace of mind.

Healthier cereal option: Clean label ingredients make it a better choice for health-conscious consumers.

Nutrient-packed breakfast: Fortification with key vitamins and minerals contributes to daily nutritional needs.

Great for snacking and recipes: Enjoy it as a snack, in trail mix, or as the base of homemade Chex Mix.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Corn Meal, Sugar, Corn Starch, Honey, Salt, Molasses, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Natural Almond Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
